welcome.title: Welcome to Planner
welcome.text: A two minute tour: where things live, how to plan a day and how the assistant helps. You can skip it at any time and replay it from Settings.

nav.title: Navigation
nav.text: Today is your daily plan. Week shows seven days side by side, Inbox keeps tasks without a day, Insights shows your trends.

projects.title: Projects
projects.text: Group tasks by area, work or personal. Every project has a short code like WORK or LIFE that appears next to its tasks. Add new ones with the plus button.

quickAdd.title: Create your first task
quickAdd.text: Type what needs to be done and press Enter. With the assistant button you can write a whole note, like "call the bank tomorrow at 10, buy a gift", and it becomes separate tasks.
quickAdd.textPlain: Type what needs to be done and press Enter. The task lands on today, you can change the day, time and project later.

task.title: Working with a task
task.text: Tick the square when it is done. Tap the title to edit the day, time, duration, priority and project. Drag the handle on the left to reorder, the menu moves it to tomorrow or the inbox.

weekStrip.title: Move between days
weekStrip.text: Drag a task onto any day of this strip to move it there. Tap a day to open it. The dots show how many tasks each day has.

views.title: Filters and views
views.text: Show only work or only personal tasks. Schedule puts tasks with a start time on an hour grid.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.text: Plan the day builds a realistic schedule inside your working hours, Tips gives advice from your recent history, and the chat proposes tasks you accept with one tap.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Name, timezone, working hours, theme and language live here. You can also replay this guide.

done.title: You are all set
done.text: Plan today, capture everything else in the inbox, and check Insights at the end of the week.
